dates.note: tradition: Sivasutras revealed on Mahadeva mountain rock

name: Vasugupta
summary: Source-point of the Trika/Spanda line: the Sivasutras (terse aphorisms of recognition) and, on one transmitted account, the teacher whose doctrine Kallata versified as the Spandakarikas (authorship disputed — Vasugupta vs Kallata recensions differ, preserve both).
bio: Source-point of the Trika/Spanda line (c. 850): the Sivasutras, revealed on Mahadeva mountain rock, and — on one transmitted account — the doctrine Kallata versified as the Spandakarikas (authorship disputed across recensions; both readings kept).

image.caption: Birch-bark Sharada manuscript of Shaivite ritual paddhatis, Tuebingen Ma I 404 (PD). The script-and-birch culture transmitting his sutras; folio shown is ritual manual, not his text.
